---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem you're trying to solve. What can't you do right now that you wish you could?

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches have you thought about? Why do you prefer your proposed solution?

## Implementation Notes

Any technical details, constraints, or implementation ideas that might be helpful.

## Would you be willing to contribute this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to open a PR for this
- [ ] Yes, but I'd need some guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting it
